verdict.rationale: The evidence shows incident.io has an On-call product with alerts, escalation paths, and schedules, so this axis applies. Nothing in the pack documents delivering pages by push, SMS, phone call, or email, or per-channel personal notification rules. Escalation-path rules based on priority and working hours are a related but different control and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, pages reach me over the channels I choose — push, SMS, phone call, and email — with per-channel notification rules
